title: Vatican Thirteen
subtitle: Test your understanding of Vatican Thirteen — the 13-level complex under the Vatican, the faction portals, the soul-transit array, and the Smithsonian vaults.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Thirteen levels under the surface castle keep distrustful factions apart, each with its own portal. Souls still pass through the sun and the Grey array before a narrow birth choice, while the Smithsonian vaults keep the contradicting remains out of public sight.

questions.question: What constitutes the true origin of the surface architecture of the Vatican?

options.label: A
options.text: Subterranean vault masonry raised by the Smithsonian from its sealed floors.
options.rationale: The Smithsonian keeps vaults under its own public floors, while the Vatican surface is older stolen stonework.

options.label: B
options.text: Isolated Alpha Draco quarters built as the surface castle over the portals.
options.rationale: Alpha Draco has an isolated command level underground, and the surface is Tartarian stonework and art.

options.label: C
options.text: Repurposed Tartarian architecture falsely attributed to figures like Michelangelo.
options.rationale: The surface edifice consists of repurposed Tartarian architecture, with fraudulent labels such as Michelangelo and Leonardo da Vinci.

options.label: D
options.text: New stonework and art made by Michelangelo and Leonardo da Vinci for the surface during later historical cycles.
options.rationale: Those names are fraudulent labels placed over older pre-existing works, not the makers of a new surface.

questions.hint: Look at what the surface edifice is said to consist of.

questions.question: How many subterranean levels comprise the underground command complex of Vatican Thirteen?

options.label: A
options.text: Exactly 10 levels.
options.rationale: The counted depth is the 13 levels below ground, not a ten-level stack.

options.label: B
options.text: Exactly 7 levels.
options.rationale: The complex extends exactly 13 levels below ground, one structure for the separated factions.

options.label: C
options.text: Exactly 13 levels.
options.rationale: The functional core is a vast underground complex extending exactly 13 levels below ground.

options.label: D
options.text: Exactly 21 levels.
options.rationale: The facility stops at the 13 levels below ground that house the factions and portals.

questions.hint: Look at how far the underground complex extends below the surface structure.

questions.question: What primary problem prompted the creation of a single consolidated subterranean facility for competing parasitic factions?

options.label: A
options.text: Absolute mutual distrust among independent parasitic groups preventing shared space.
options.rationale: The facility was built to solve absolute mutual distrust, because the groups could not share unmonitored space or transit routes.

options.label: B
options.text: Public discovery of Tartarian stonework in open archaeological sites.
options.rationale: Tartarian stonework was relabeled on the surface, while the complex was built because the factions could not share space.

options.label: C
options.text: A shortage of loosh harvesting gear across the surface slaughterhouses and entertainment quarters.
options.rationale: Loosh harvesting runs inside the finished complex, and the build was prompted by distrust among the factions.

options.label: D
options.text: A breakdown of the portal array caused by the solar re-formatting cycle.
options.rationale: The sun re-formats souls before they enter a working portal array, and the complex was built to separate distrustful factions.

questions.hint: Look at why the ruling groups could not share space or transit routes.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT an isolated level assignment inside Vatican Thirteen?

options.label: A
options.text: Specialized levels assigned to high-tier Demons and their consorts.
options.rationale: The Demonic Chambers are specialized levels assigned to high-tier Demons and their consorts.

options.label: B
options.text: Administrative and oversight level operated by the Custodians.
options.rationale: The Custodians Level is the administrative and oversight level operated by the Custodians.

options.label: C
options.text: Air-sealed vault that sequesters giant remains beneath public exhibit floors.
options.rationale: Historical artifacts recovered from excavation projects are permanently sequestered under the Smithsonian, not on a Vatican faction level.

options.label: D
options.text: Dedicated operational headquarters for the Omicron entity group inside its own sealed floor.
options.rationale: The Omicron Level is the dedicated operational headquarters for the Omicron entity group.

questions.hint: Check the faction level list and notice which claim belongs to another building.

questions.question: Why does each subterranean level possess its own independent portal access?

options.label: A
options.text: To keep soul harvesting from crowding a single gate during death transit.
options.rationale: Soul redistribution sits on one portal level, while the separate portals exist so factions do not share transit points.

options.label: B
options.text: To enable entities to travel without sharing unmonitored transit points with rival groups.
options.rationale: Each faction could travel independently without sharing transit points with rival groups.

options.label: C
options.text: To give bloodline members a direct road from their level into the Smithsonian vaults beneath the exhibits.
options.rationale: Smithsonian access is a separate restriction, and these portals let factions travel without sharing transit points.

options.label: D
options.text: To move re-formatted souls from the sun straight into the adrenochrome warehouses.
options.rationale: Re-formatted souls go to a target country, and the separate portals exist so rivals do not share transit points.

questions.hint: Connect the separate portals to the distrust between the factions.

questions.question: What initial cosmic step occurs to a human soul following physical death before it enters the Vatican portal array?

options.label: A
options.text: Immediate pairing with a twin flame before a country is assigned.
options.rationale: The exit point under the Vatican prevents soul groups or twin flames from reuniting.

options.label: B
options.text: Review by the Custodians on the administrative oversight level.
options.rationale: The Custodians run oversight of the levels, while soul processing starts with the sun and then the Greys.

options.label: C
options.text: Passage through the sun for automated re-formatting.
options.rationale: Following physical death, human souls pass through the sun for automated re-formatting and then enter the portal array.

options.label: D
options.text: Direct placement into an adrenochrome warehouse on the lower levels.
options.rationale: Adrenochrome warehouses are physical stockpiles, and the soul first passes through the sun.

questions.hint: Look at the step after physical death and before the portal array.

questions.question: Which parasitic faction directly manages the incarnational technology and soul transit process beneath the Vatican?

options.label: A
options.text: The Greys
options.rationale: The Greys utilize specialized incarnational technology, and Grey operators escort the re-formatted soul onward.

options.label: B
options.text: The Anuk
options.rationale: The Anuk hold a functional headquarters, and the incarnational technology belongs to the Greys.

options.label: C
options.text: High-tier Demons
options.rationale: High-tier Demons and their consorts have specialized chambers, while the Greys run the incarnational technology.

options.label: D
options.text: The Alpha Draco
options.rationale: Alpha Draco has an isolated command level, and soul transit is overseen with Grey incarnational technology.

questions.hint: Look at which group is tied to incarnational technology on its own level.

questions.question: What choice is available to a re-formatted soul during the final stage of the Grey-managed birth transit?

options.label: A
options.text: A return path through the sun that ends the loop for that soul.
options.rationale: The sun is the re-formatting step, and the path continues to a target country under Grey escort.

options.label: B
options.text: Limited selection over mothers currently giving birth in a designated target country.
options.rationale: In that country the soul exercises limited selection over mothers currently giving birth.

options.label: C
options.text: Selection of a verified bloodline lineage before the soul reenters the target country under Grey escort.
options.rationale: Verified bloodline lineages are an access class, and the soul does not pick that status on the way in.

options.label: D
options.text: Open choice of region and historical period after the soul leaves the sun.
options.rationale: Grey operators escort the soul to its designated target country, so the country is not an open choice.

questions.hint: Look at the narrow choice left once a soul reaches its assigned country.

questions.question: What strategic impact does controlling soul redistribution beneath the Vatican have on humanity?

options.label: A
options.text: It places incarnating souls into the verified bloodline lineages under the vaults.
options.rationale: Bloodline access is restricted, and the soul route dictates global birth distribution rather than filling those lineages.

options.label: B
options.text: It clears harvested loosh out of the slaughterhouses and adrenochrome warehouses.
options.rationale: Loosh harvesting stays in operation inside the complex, and the soul exit controls birth distribution.

options.label: C
options.text: It speeds technical progress across the surface nations that receive the births.
options.rationale: The exit point is used to dictate global birth distribution, not to speed surface technical progress.

options.label: D
options.text: It prevents soul groups and twin flames from reuniting while dictating global birth distribution.
options.rationale: Parasitic factions dictate global birth distribution and prevent soul groups or twin flames from reuniting.

questions.hint: Look at the broader effect of holding the exit point under the Vatican.

questions.question: What feature defines the Greys Level within the subterranean complex structure?

options.label: A
options.text: Primary slaughterhouse level kept for luxury entertainment.
options.rationale: Luxury slaughterhouses serve resident entities, while the Greys Level is the technical and navigational level.

options.label: B
options.text: Administrative and oversight level operated by the Custodians.
options.rationale: Administrative oversight is the Custodians Level, and the Greys hold the technical and navigational level.

options.label: C
options.text: Technical and navigational level designated for the Greys.
options.rationale: The Greys Level is the technical and navigational level designated for the Greys.

options.label: D
options.text: Storage level for giant remains sequestered from excavation projects.
options.rationale: Giant remains stay in the Smithsonian vaults, and the Greys Level is technical and navigational.

questions.hint: Look at the level list for the group tied to portal machinery.

questions.question: What is stockpiled in the lower levels of Vatican Thirteen alongside cages of captive children?

options.label: A
options.text: Spare Tartarian stonework held below the surface castle as a building store.
options.rationale: Tartarian stonework is the surface edifice, and the lower stockpile is adrenochrome beside the cages.

options.label: B
options.text: Sanitized exhibits prepared for the public upper floors of the museum.
options.rationale: Sanitized exhibits belong on Smithsonian public floors, while the lower Vatican levels stock adrenochrome.

options.label: C
options.text: Extensive adrenochrome storage warehouses.
options.rationale: Lower levels house spare cages of captive children alongside extensive adrenochrome storage warehouses.

options.label: D
options.text: Portal arrays that forward re-formatted souls toward a target country.
options.rationale: The portal array handles souls, and the stockpile beside the cages is extensive adrenochrome storage.

questions.hint: Look at the stockpile kept on the lower levels beside the cages.

questions.question: What amenities are provided within the subterranean levels for resident entities and their consorts?

options.label: A
options.text: Art studios teaching Tartarian stonework under Michelangelo's name.
options.rationale: Michelangelo is a fraudulent label on older work, not a studio program for the resident entities.

options.label: B
options.text: Sanitized exhibit halls and open vaults for ordinary human visitors.
options.rationale: Ordinary human beings are kept out of the sealed vaults, and the resident amenities are slaughterhouses and entertainment.

options.label: C
options.text: Shared navigation bays and portals opened for rival factions on one floor.
options.rationale: Portals are unshared, and the quarters for residents are luxury slaughterhouses and entertainment.

options.label: D
options.text: Luxury slaughterhouses and high-end entertainment quarters.
options.rationale: The facility contains luxury slaughterhouses and high-end entertainment quarters for resident entities and their consorts.

questions.hint: Look at what the resident entities and their consorts are given inside the complex.

questions.question: What role does loosh harvesting play within the operational framework of Vatican Thirteen?

options.label: A
options.text: It holds the Tartarian masonry of the surface castle in place.
options.rationale: The surface masonry is stolen Tartarian stonework, and loosh belongs to the energetic harvest below.

options.label: B
options.text: It powers the sun's automated re-formatting before souls reach the portal array beneath the Vatican.
options.rationale: The sun performs automated re-formatting, and loosh is an energetic harvest inside the complex.

options.label: C
options.text: It masks the Smithsonian vaults so the sealed floors stay hidden.
options.rationale: Those vaults stay hidden by access rules, while loosh is part of the harvesting inside Vatican Thirteen.

options.label: D
options.text: It serves as an energetic resource extracted alongside physical harvesting across the facility.
options.rationale: Vast spaces are dedicated to physical and energetic harvesting, and loosh harvesting runs with the warehouses.

questions.hint: Look at the energetic harvest that runs beside the physical one.

questions.question: Which institution is described as fulfilling an identical subterranean containment role for archaeology in North America?

options.label: A
options.text: The Anuk headquarters level
options.rationale: The Anuk Level is a faction headquarters, and the North American archaeological body is the Smithsonian.

options.label: B
options.text: The Smithsonian Institution
options.rationale: The Smithsonian maintains sealed subterranean vaults and is recognized as the archaeological counterpart to the Vatican.

options.label: C
options.text: The Greys' navigational level
options.rationale: The Greys run a technical level under the Vatican, and the archaeological counterpart is the Smithsonian.

options.label: D
options.text: The Custodians' administrative level
options.rationale: That level is inside Vatican Thirteen, and the North American archaeological counterpart is the Smithsonian.

questions.hint: Look for the North American body that mirrors the Vatican's underground access rules.

questions.question: Who is granted access to the subterranean vaults beneath the public floors of the Smithsonian Institution?

options.label: A
options.text: Mothers currently giving birth in the designated target country.
options.rationale: Those mothers are part of soul transit, and the vaults are reserved for parasites and verified bloodline lineages.

options.label: B
options.text: Non-human parasites and verified bloodline lineages exclusively.
options.rationale: Access is reserved exclusively for non-human parasites and verified bloodline lineages.

options.label: C
options.text: Figureheads such as Michelangelo and Leonardo da Vinci on the surface works.
options.rationale: Those names are fraudulent labels, and vault access belongs to parasites and verified bloodline lineages.

options.label: D
options.text: Ordinary human beings who staff the sanitized exhibits on the public floors.
options.rationale: Access below public sight lines is prohibited to ordinary human beings.

questions.hint: Look at who may go below the public floors.

questions.question: What physical evidence is stored inside the air-sealed subterranean vaults of the Smithsonian Institution?

options.label: A
options.text: Out-of-place physical evidence, giant remains, and suppressed artifacts.
options.rationale: The vaults sequester out-of-place physical evidence, giant remains, and historical artifacts recovered from excavation projects.

options.label: B
options.text: Signed stonework credited to Michelangelo and Leonardo da Vinci.
options.rationale: Those names are fraudulent labels on Tartarian work, and the vaults hold giant remains and historical artifacts.

options.label: C
options.text: Re-formatted souls waiting for escort to mothers who are giving birth.
options.rationale: Souls move through the Vatican portal array, and the Smithsonian vaults hold excavated physical evidence.

options.label: D
options.text: Grey incarnational machines that run the portal array under the Vatican for soul escort.
options.rationale: Incarnational technology stays with the Greys under the Vatican, and the vaults hold excavated remains and artifacts.

questions.hint: Look at what excavated material the vaults keep out of sight.

questions.question: Why are ordinary human beings prohibited from accessing the levels beneath the Smithsonian public floors?

options.label: A
options.text: To keep visitors away from the portal array that receives souls from the sun.
options.rationale: That portal array is beneath the Vatican, and the Smithsonian ban keeps the vaults hidden from public view.

options.label: B
options.text: To prevent public discovery of artifacts that contradict approved historical narratives.
options.rationale: The vaults remain air-sealed and hidden from public view so giant remains and historical artifacts stay sequestered.

options.label: C
options.text: To reserve entertainment quarters for the figureheads named on the stonework.
options.rationale: Entertainment quarters are for resident entities under the Vatican, and the Smithsonian ban protects sequestered evidence.

options.label: D
options.text: To shield stolen Tartarian stonework from visitors walking the public floors of the surface castle.
options.rationale: Tartarian stonework is the Vatican surface, and the Smithsonian ban keeps excavated evidence sequestered.

questions.hint: Look at the reason the vaults stay closed to ordinary human beings.

questions.question: What complementary division of labor exists between the Vatican and the Smithsonian Institution?

options.label: A
options.text: The Vatican builds the portal infrastructure while the Smithsonian recruits bloodline host species.
options.rationale: The Custodians established the Vatican levels, and the Smithsonian manages physical archaeology and material history.

options.label: B
options.text: The Vatican controls religious, energetic, and soul-transit vectors, while the Smithsonian manages physical history.
options.rationale: The Vatican holds those vectors, and the Smithsonian manages physical archaeology and material history.

options.label: C
options.text: The Vatican oversees surface entertainment while the Smithsonian manages subterranean slaughterhouses.
options.rationale: Slaughterhouses and entertainment quarters are inside Vatican Thirteen, not under the Smithsonian.

options.label: D
options.text: The Vatican manages European archaeology while the Smithsonian handles global soul transit.
options.rationale: Soul transit sits with the Vatican, and the Smithsonian manages physical archaeology and material history.

questions.hint: Separate the Vatican's vectors from the Smithsonian's material work.

questions.question: How did parasitic controllers successfully sever humanity from its authentic historical past?

options.label: A
options.text: By pulling down the surface castle and the Tartarian stonework it carried.
options.rationale: The stonework was kept and relabeled, and artifacts were locked in vaults rather than the castle being pulled down.

options.label: B
options.text: By cloaking stolen Tartarian works under false attributions and locking physical artifacts in sealed vaults.
options.rationale: They cloak stolen Tartarian stonework under false artistic attributions and lock physical artifacts in sealed underground vaults.

options.label: C
options.text: By swapping human bloodlines for non-human hosts across the realm.
options.rationale: Bloodline lineages stay a restricted access class, and the break with the past uses false labels and sealed vaults.

options.label: D
options.text: By sending living people through the sun so memory fails before death.
options.rationale: Passage through the sun happens after physical death, and the historical break uses false labels and sealed vaults.

questions.hint: Look at how stolen stonework and excavated objects were handled.

questions.question: What role does false attribution play in the preservation of the surface narrative?

options.label: A
options.text: It places fraudulent labels over older Tartarian works to conceal true origin.
options.rationale: Fraudulent labels placed over older pre-existing works obscure true historical origin.

options.label: B
options.text: It stirs new artistic work among soul groups that were kept apart.
options.rationale: False attribution obscures true historical origin, and separated soul groups are a birth-routing result.

options.label: C
options.text: It lets the Greys track artistic twin flames across target countries.
options.rationale: The soul route prevents twin flames from reuniting, and false names hide the origin of older works.

options.label: D
options.text: It disguises the portal array as a museum exhibit on the public floors.
options.rationale: The portal array stays under the Vatican, and false attribution covers older Tartarian works.

questions.hint: Look at what the famous names on the older stonework actually do.

questions.question: How did the Custodians ensure long-term operational stability among host and entity species?

options.label: A
options.text: By moving the portal array out of the Vatican and into the Smithsonian vaults.
options.rationale: The portal array stays beneath the Vatican, and stability came from isolated levels inside one structure.

options.label: B
options.text: By letting human souls pick birth mothers with no limit on the choice.
options.rationale: The soul has a limited selection of mothers, and faction stability came from isolated levels in one structure.

options.label: C
options.text: By opening the faction levels to surface governments as a shared settlement.
options.rationale: The levels stay secret, and stability came from isolated infrastructure inside one 13-level structure.

options.label: D
options.text: By housing all hostile factions in one 13-level structure with dedicated isolated infrastructure.
options.rationale: That single structure gave operational stability for parasitic control while each group kept an isolated level.

questions.hint: Look at the architectural arrangement that reduced warfare between the factions.

questions.question: True or False: In previous historical cycles, the surface building existed as a castle.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: In previous historical cycles, the surface building existed as a castle.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The core revelations state that the surface building existed as a castle in previous historical cycles.

questions.hint: Look at the surface building in previous historical cycles.

questions.question: True or False: The Greys established and managed the 13 subterranean levels.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The Custodians are the primary architect entity group that established and managed those levels.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The Custodians, not the Greys, are the primary architect entity group that established and managed the levels.

questions.hint: Look at which group established and managed the 13 levels.

questions.question: True or False: The Anuk Level is the functional headquarters assigned to the Anunnaki.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The Anuk Level is the functional headquarters assigned to the Anuk (Anunnaki).

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The level list gives the Anuk a functional headquarters assigned to the Anuk (Anunnaki).

questions.hint: Look at the level list for the group named beside Anuk.

questions.question: True or False: Rival factions share one monitored portal on each level.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The groups were unable to share unmonitored space or transit routes, so each level kept its own portal.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: They were unable to share unmonitored space or transit routes, and each faction kept portal access on its own level.

questions.hint: Look at whether rival factions use one shared transit point.
